versions.changelog: 新增股票新闻功能，查询行情时自动显示3条热门新闻

Stock Tracker Pro 1.0.0

- Initial release of stock-tracker-pro.
- Add, remove, and list monitored stocks using easy commands.
- Fetch real-time stock data from Yahoo Finance, including price, market cap, volume, 52-week high/low, PE, earnings, and dividend.
- Supports commands like “监控 AAPL”, “删除 TSLA”, and “AAPL 股价”.
- Stores monitored stock list at /home/frank/.openclaw/workspace/skills/stock-tracker-pro/stocks.json.
